name: Icon
description: A small symbol, usually an inline <svg>, that supports a text label or stands in for one. Decorative icons are hidden from screen readers; an icon that carries meaning on its own needs a text alternative.

elements.name: Symbol
elements.description: The SVG shape, sized to the text or control around it

elements.name: Visible label
elements.description: Text beside the icon; when present, the icon is decorative

elements.name: Accessible name
elements.description: role="img" with aria-label, or Visually hidden text, when the icon carries meaning alone

configOptions.options: Inherit text size, Small, Medium, Large

variants.caption: Position — before text, after text, alone
Background shape — circle and rounded square

usageNotes: Hide decorative icons with aria-hidden="true" so screen readers don't announce them next to a visible label. Older guidance also adds focusable="false" to the <svg>.

An icon that stands alone and carries meaning needs a text alternative (WCAG 1.1.1): role="img" with aria-label, or Visually hidden text. In an icon-only Button, give the name to the button, not the icon.
Don't rely on an icon's shape or color alone to convey status; pair it with text (WCAG 1.4.1 Use of Color).
Icons that convey information need a contrast ratio of at least 3:1 against their background (WCAG 1.4.11 Non-text Contrast).
Use fill="currentColor" and size icons in em so they follow the color and size of the text around them.
htmlOutline:
<!-- decorative -->
<svg aria-hidden="true" focusable="false">…</svg>

<!-- meaningful -->
<svg role="img" aria-label="Warning">…</svg>
